invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception if operationType is LOG_COMPACT, so operationType must not be null to avoid a NullPointerException in the equals call.
instantTime is used as an argument to getCompactionInflightInstant, so it must not be null.
Methods are called on table; it cannot be null at method exit.
Methods are called on pendingCompactionTimeline; it cannot be null at method exit.
The method throws an exception and does not exit normally if operationType is LOG_COMPACT.
